decisive_items: dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+
PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement
response.rationale: The presence of atypical lymphocytes with specific immunophenotyping and a clonal IgH gene rearrangement supports the diagnosis of a B-cell lymphoma, specifically diffuse large B-cell lymphoma

rejected.why: The clonal IgH gene rearrangement points more towards a B-cell lymphoma, contradicting the diagnosis of Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type

While the clinical presentation and imaging findings could be consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, the immunophenotypic markers and clonal IgH gene rearrangement support a B-cell lymphoma diagnosis
The expression of B-cell markers makes cutaneous T-cell lymphoma less likely
